name: nusa
description: Windows Electron paper-trading and deterministic research platform
author: NUSA contributors

scripts.preflight: node scripts/check-runtime.js && node scripts/validate-repository-portability.js && node scripts/validate-platform-independent-tests.js && node scripts/validate-android-release-contract.js && node scripts/validate-aipos-yaml.js
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:desktop && pnpm run lint:scripts && pnpm run lint:mobile
scripts.test: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/run-tests-isolated.js
scripts.architecture:check: node scripts/validate-architecture.js && node scripts/validate-research-architecture.js && node scripts/validate-architecture-surfaces.js
scripts.package:win: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/validate-package.js && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.package:portable: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/validate-package.js && electron-builder --config electron-builder.portable.yml --win portable
scripts.release:check: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && node scripts/release-readiness.js
scripts.evidence:rehearse: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/evidence-rehearse.js
scripts.evidence:status: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/evidence-cli.js status
scripts.evidence:checklist: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/evidence-checklist.js
scripts.evidence:export: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/evidence-cli.js export
scripts.evidence:verify: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/evidence-cli.js verify
scripts.research:evidence-import: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/import-research-evidence.js
scripts.research:evidence-bundle-import: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/import-research-evidence-bundle.js
scripts.opportunity:schedule-import: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/import-opportunity-schedule.js
scripts.research:evidence-status: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/research-evidence-status.js
scripts.runtime:diagnostics-validate: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/validate-runtime-diagnostics.js
scripts.research:real-run: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node -r ./scripts/research-replay-snapshot-capture.js scripts/research-real-market-run.js
scripts.validate: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run architecture:truth && pnpm run safety:architecture && pnpm run ai:architecture
scripts.validate:full: pnpm run validate && pnpm run architecture:check && pnpm run aipos:drift && pnpm run aipos:conformance && pnpm run safety:invariants && pnpm run safety:inputs
